title: Adopt the Self-Development Rule and enforce monotonic authority
decided_at_provenance: RECONSTRUCTED from the operator session on 2026-08-27; the AGREE was given in chat and recorded here after the fact. Future decisions are recorded at decision time.

authorizes.summary: Commit docs/governance/SELF_DEVELOPMENT_RULE.md as normative; add verify_monotonic_authority() to the repo gate refusing any reduction of required_roles, reserved_actions, or rules.minimum_class versus the last authorized baseline; adversarial tests, mutation verification, CI negative control.
excluded: badf/authority-matrix.json -- policy unchanged; only the guard changed

authority_downgrade.note: This decision STRENGTHENS authority. It does not admit any downgrade; a downgrade ack citing it must be refused.

evidence: negative control PR #2 run 33044484934; corrected by PR #3 run 33044787967 (step 4 FAIL: authority downgrade refused)
invalidation: Any material change to scope, authority class, or the enacting implementation invalidates this decision; a new decision is required.
